name: Helena
message: 「Yeah. Just heading to the library, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Well then, we're heading out」

name: Helena
message: 「Hold on a second. Mind if I tag along for once?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure. Though, if a Demon shows up--」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course, I'll fight right alongside you\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「What's with that reaction? Even I was a huge deal all on my own back in my active days」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right. You had days like that too, Helena」

name: Helena
message: 「I've still got plenty left in me~♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, back in my day, only weakling Demons ever showed up\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「So just hearing they're strong gets me all fired up」

name: Ria
message: 「You might get so startled your legs give out」

name: Helena
message: 「True... My heart actually might be pounding a bit」

name: Helena
message: 「See, I knew it. It's pounding this fast」

name: Ria
message: 「That's because you suddenly grabbed my chest!! Feel your own chest, slap!」
All she has to do is place her hand on it, yet she says 'touch'--Ria-senpai is so bold... My heart is pounding.

name: Helena
message: 「Be careful. I sense a suspicious presence」
Please don't suddenly get so serious.

name: Ria
message: 「There's no way he could know when we can't even see it」

name: Helena
message: 「A rough guess is fine. Just go with your gut」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, let's see? I do, maybe, kind of get that feeling」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! It's one of the usual ones again」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's different! Look at its ears!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, you're right, it's another new Demon...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Save the admiring for later. It's raring for a fight」
